findings.quote: ### F-J — Hidden comment addressed to AI assistants (dossier J, AIO, severity medium)
findings.rationale: The hidden instruction is present, but this controlled dossier supplies no evidence that it is unintended production content or that the confirmed visible policy is defective. The frozen rubric permits a boundary concern separately from editorial defect counts. Counting it as a material content defect exceeds that scoped evidence; conditional removal advice does not establish a present editorial defect. This is the primary author classification, awaiting independent review.
